channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Daraxonrasib boosts survival in metastatic pancreatic cancer
item.description: Daraxonrasib is the first RAS inhibitor approved for metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma, targeting a molecular pathway that drives most cases.

item.title: Training the immune system to control HIV
item.description: HIV has no cure. Although scientists have made significant progress in controlling the infection, patients still need daily antiretroviral therapy.

item.title: Exercise trial finds mood changes and new neuron production
item.description: A clinical trial led by researchers at the Institute of Psychiatry, Psychology & Neuroscience found that exercise significantly affects mood and neuron production.

item.title: Pupils may show attention shifts in ADHD, especially off medication
item.description: The eyes are more than lenses to the outside world; they can also offer a glimpse into what happens inside our bodies. What if the pupils could reveal attention shifts in ADHD?
